payload.title: Homepage: How we work section leads with discipline, case studies before method
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-09-26: a prospect may have read the Cybernetic Development section as 'we vibe-code everything'. The first sentence ('AI is an engine for generating code') told an unfamiliar reader what the coined term meant. Fix: heading becomes How we work; opener leads with specs, tests, staged rollout, and a person who can say no, then names cybernetic development as the term for it; case studies move above the section so proof precedes method; article link text becomes How we govern AI-built systems. H1 and hero untouched.
